images.filename: A view of the Castle Grounds (1) - geograph.org.uk - 862765.jpg
images.caption: A view of  the Castle Grounds  (1) This photograph shows Tamworth town centre's Castle Grounds, where people go especially in the spring and summer to soak up some sunshine and have a chat with friends, whether it be people that are on their lunch break or out for a bit of fresh air. The structure to the left of the photograph with the pointed roof is the Castle grounds bandstand, where performances are held, behind me is the Ankerside Shopping Centre, which has an entrance which allows easy access to the Castle Grounds.
images.alt: A view of  the Castle Grounds  (1) This photograph shows Tamworth town centre's Castle Grounds, where people go especially in the spring and summer to soak up some sunshine and have a chat with friends, whether it be people that are on their lunch break or out for a bit of fresh air. categories: Images from Geograph Britain and Ireland

images.filename: A view of the Castle Grounds (10) - geograph.org.uk - 867537.jpg
images.caption: A view of the Castle Grounds  (10) This photograph shows the entrance to Market Street from the Castle Grounds which is accessed by a small bridge that spans the ruins of Tamworth Castles stone Gatehouse that was built circa 1260 -1270, which replaced the previous Norman era Wooden Gateway. Tamworth Castle is to my left out of shot, this path is the same as the one shown in photographs such as 864117  864181  866983

images.filename: A view of the Castle Grounds (4) - geograph.org.uk - 864117.jpg
images.caption: A view of the Castle Grounds  (4) This photograph shows another part of the Castle Grounds with Tamworth Castle in the background. The path that can be seen going past the square flower box goes upwards towards the steep walkway to Tamworth Castle's entrance. The same pathway goes into the Town centre, it also connects to another pathway which leads to the entrance of Ankerside Shopping centre. The flower beds on the incline next to the bandstand that are in photographs, A view of the Castle Grounds 1 862765 , 2 862795, 3 862815  are behind me.

images.filename: A view of the Castle Grounds (5) - geograph.org.uk - 864181.jpg
images.caption: A view of the Castle Grounds  (5) This photograph shows the Castle Grounds from another angle, the building in the distance to the right hand side is the old Tamworth Council building, which is no longer in use as the Council moved to new premises years ago. The building seen in the centre of the photograph in the distance and the wall on its left hand side are part of the Castle and its grounds.

images.caption:
Rugby town hall in Rugby town centre, in Warwickshire, England. The hall is the headquarters of Rugby Borough Council, and was opened in 1961. 
The earlier town hall in the High Street is now a Marks and Spencers shop.

Photo by G-Man April 2005
